localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter each) across the low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface, appearing as high-contrast voids in the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of white and pinkish-white calcified clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the rightmost distal tip and periodic rounded protuberances along the superior margin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible anatomical structure is a pectoral fin, not a fluke; identified by the presence of prominent leading-edge tubercles and an elongated, narrow geometry tapering toward the distal end.
